method.LPIPS: AlexNet v0.1, full-resolution RGB, lower is closer to BF16
method.SSIM: RGB Gaussian 11x11 window, sigma 1.5, population covariance, higher is closer to BF16
method.frames: All 124 decoded frames, matched by index; no resize, registration or selection
method.time: One first request per model, including CPU offload, generation and encoding; excludes loading and offline weight packing

limitations: Single scene and seed; frame similarity is affected by divergent motion and is not a general quality score.
Quantized arms ran on GPU 3; BF16 is retained from GPU 0 of the same machine. These are not steady-state production speed measurements.
Full deployment includes language encoder, DiT and video decoder; the result does not isolate DiT QAD training.

precision.Online and QAD: NVFP4 linear layers plus native FP4 sparse attention; native prefix QK uses FP8 and PV uses BF16
precision.QAD + CAKE: Same QAD weights with alternative INT8 QK / FP8 V attention
precision.retained_higher_precision: Vision tower, audio VAE, norms, boundary modules and sparse routing

validation: Native attention adapter matched the upstream function exactly on two ragged test cases. Four-video browser playback and shared seek passed. PowerPoint static checks passed with the requested video-playback timing exception; native PowerPoint playback was not tested.
